App MatiPay is the payment system that enables you to purchase in a few simple steps from vending machines using your IPhone.

Do you want to buy from vending machines but don't have your wallet? Don't have coins but fancy a coffee or a snack?
MatiPay App is designed just for you!

How does it work?
- Download the app from the store
- Turn on Bluetooth
- Register or log in with Apple ID or Facebook
- Connect to the vending machine by approaching your iPhone
- Top up your virtual wallet with coins and / or credit card or PayPal
- Start buying directly from the MatiPay app with your IPhone!

With the MatiPay app you can:
- receive discounts and exclusive promotions
- book your break (available upon activation)
- collect points with the loyalty program (available upon activation)
- send credit to your friends
- keep track of the products you buy
- associate NFC gadgets to buy even in places where the phone is not allowed (available upon activation)
- report malfunctions of the distributor
- report out of stock products

How can I top up my virtual purse with coins?
To recharge with coins: connect to the vending machine by bringing the phone close to the MatiPay payment module and wait a few seconds: the orange LED will light up.
Is the led orange? You are connected! Insert the coins into the coin mechanism and the credit will be updated in real time!
Select the product you want to buy!

How can I top up my virtual wallet with a credit card?
To recharge by credit card: click on the ""Recharge"" button on the Homepage and enter the data from your credit card.
At the end of the recharge procedure, connect to the distributor and select the product you want to buy!
